# Principia Robotica

> The world's first unified Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway and real-time Control Barrier Function (CBF-QP) safety engine for embodied AI and autonomous robotics. Operates at 12,000Hz (sub-millisecond latency) guaranteeing mathematically proven forward set invariance between Large Language Models and physical ROS 2 hardware actuators.

## Architecture & Core Modules
- [principia.cbf_engine](principia/cbf_engine.py): Continuous and discrete Control Barrier Functions (CBF), Lie derivative evaluations, circular obstacle CBF, altitude floor CBF, dynamic obstacle CBF, and quadratic programming solver with analytical projection fallback.
- [principia.world_model](principia/world_model.py): 1000Hz kinematic forward trajectory pre-simulator certifying future waypoints, and real-time Lyapunov exponential stability analyzer V(x) = 0.5 * ||x - x_goal||^2.
- [principia.server](principia/server.py): JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing 14 tools with O(1) hash dispatch mapping.
- [principia.tools](principia/tools.py): Comprehensive MCP tool handlers for differential drive filtering, swarm fleet safety, quadrotor altitude protection, and ASCII radar maps.
- [principia.linalg](principia/linalg.py): Zero-dependency pure Python linear algebra backend (Vec, Mat) executing on any CPU architecture without native wheel dependencies.
- [principia.ros2_bridge](principia/ros2_bridge.py): Thread-safe real-time ROS 2 node bridging /cmd_vel_raw from AI agents to /cmd_vel on hardware with odometry state feedback.

## Tools & Capabilities
- `cbf_filter_velocity`: Projects AI-proposed (v, omega) velocity commands onto the safe set with minimum L2 perturbation.
- `predict_safe_trajectory`: Pre-simulates trajectory 3.0s into the future at 1000Hz, verifying barrier constraints before actuation.
- `lyapunov_stability_check`: Verifies exponential goal convergence via Lyapunov derivative dV/dt <= -2 * epsilon * V.
- `cbf_quadrotor_altitude`: Enforces minimum altitude ceiling/floor barrier constraint h(x) = z - z_min >= 0 on thrust.
- `get_cbf_safety_report`: Full mathematical safety audit evaluating all barrier function margins for current state.
- `minimal_perturbation_proof`: Computes Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) optimality proof confirming minimum-norm correction.
- `clf_cbf_qp_solver`: Unifies Control Lyapunov Function goal seeking with hard Control Barrier Function safety via slack variables.
- `swarm_cbf_fleet_safety`: Evaluates pairwise inter-robot distance barriers h_ij = ||p_i - p_j||^2 - d_min^2 across N fleet robots.
- `dynamic_obstacle_cbf`: Moving obstacle avoidance accounting for obstacle relative velocity vectors and partial time derivatives.
- `get_cbf_spatial_map`: Renders a 9x9 ASCII radar map visualizing obstacle safety boundaries for LLM context windows.
- `batch_cbf_filter`: Batches velocity filter queries for an entire fleet of N robots in an atomic call.
- `principia_ui`: Serves 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas dashboard visualizer on local port 8080.
- `principia_status`: Server status, version, and registered tool capabilities summary.
- `principia_benchmark`: Automated solver latency and throughput profiling over N iterations.
